## Summary

- finalize terminal PR stops in the current progress note or trusted marker note
- use the job token for non-recursive progress updates
- mention human requesters and include cumulative planner summaries
- collapse older trusted artifacts across agent and workflow identities only after exact successes with substantive summaries
- preserve non-success context, formal reviews, and child-report behavior
- update focused documentation and regression coverage

## Verification

- `npm --prefix .agent run build`
- 90 focused handoff and minimizer tests
- 775 runtime tests
- 94 workflow checks
- 5 documentation checks
- `git diff --check`

Closes #452

## Notes

- Exact head [`6ca9c6ff`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/commit/6ca9c6ffcb45010165bf6e08ac814bb77cf8308b) passed the build, 80 handoff tests, 10 minimizer tests, 94 workflow checks, 5 documentation checks, and `git diff --check`; the hosted [PR check](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/actions/runs/32230269428/job/95998373416) also passes.
- The redo fixes the prior blocking defects by using the job token for progress replacement, cleaning both agent and workflow identities, and requiring a substantive summary before cleanup.
- Smallest useful follow-up: add a combined fallback-upsert-plus-cleanup rerun test and use an update-aware cleanup boundary while explicitly excluding the current final note.

## Findings

- **WARNING:** When progress-note merging fails, marker upsert can update a final note created during an earlier run. Cleanup then uses that comment’s unchanged database ID ([handoff](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/6ca9c6ffcb45010165bf6e08ac814bb77cf8308b/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts#L1250-L1272)) and minimizes only comments with smaller IDs ([minimizer](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/6ca9c6ffcb45010165bf6e08ac814bb77cf8308b/.agent/src/review-summary-minimize.ts#L310-L330)). Generated artifacts created after the original note but before its update therefore remain visible. Final-note publication remains deduplicated and the cleanup failure mode is safely incomplete, so this is non-blocking but only partially satisfies idempotency.

## AI Review Synthesis

<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis -->
<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis-head: 6ca9c6ffcb45010165bf6e08ac814bb77cf8308b -->

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue

PR #505 implements the lean, single-job terminal PR finalization requested by #452 and refined in #496. It reuses progress notes, mentions human requesters, records cumulative outcomes, and conditionally collapses older trusted automation comments. It resolves the previous token-identity, dual-identity cleanup, and summary-gating defects without changing authorization or release notes. The draft remains mergeable and its current checks pass.

## Review

The architecture and scope are sound, but the current head has two bounded correctness gaps in the newly added finalization path. One reviewer recommended `SHIP`, while another found these issues; direct inspection of the live head confirms both warnings.

| Issue | Severity | Disposition | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| Null ordering IDs can hide the final note | WARNING | FIX_IN_PR | `Number(null)` becomes `0`, allowing a marker-bearing comment without ordering evidence to be treated as older and minimized. |
| Closed-PR finalization loses the planner summary | WARNING | FIX_IN_PR | The closed-state check returns before reading the already-produced planner response, so a valid cumulative stop summary can be omitted. |
| Reused fallback notes limit cleanup convergence | INFO | FOLLOW_UP | Updating an older marker note retains its original database ID, leaving later generated artifacts visible. This safely preserves excess context. |

## Progress

- The three blockers from the previous implementation are fixed: progress replacement uses the job token, cleanup covers agent and workflow identities, and cleanup requires a substantive summary.
- Exact head `6ca9c6ff` passed the build, 90 focused tests, 775 runtime tests, 94 workflow checks, five documentation checks, and `git diff --check`.
- Posted inline comments for the [nullable-ID defect](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/505#discussion_r3811284152) and [closed-PR summary loss](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/505#discussion_r3811286600).
- The fallback cutoff limitation was already covered in the PR discussion, so it was not duplicated inline.
- Issue-target summary rendering and fallback publication identity remain outside the focused PR-finalization scope. Fatal terminal-note publication failure is intentional and tested.
- No existing inline feedback required replies, minimization, or thread resolution.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Null ordering IDs can hide the final note</summary>

**Cause:** The [ordering filter](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/6ca9c6ffcb45010165bf6e08ac814bb77cf8308b/.agent/src/review-summary-minimize.ts#L327) accepts `null` because `Number(null)` is zero. The final marker also matches the cleanup predicate, so missing ordering evidence can select the current note.

**Candidate solutions:**

- Require a non-null, positive safe integer before comparison.
- Add null and missing-ID regressions asserting that no minimization mutation occurs.

**Comments:** This is a small fail-closed correction directly protecting the durable final note.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Closed-PR finalization loses the planner summary</summary>

**Cause:** The workflow produces the planner response before handoff, but the [non-open PR return](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/6ca9c6ffcb45010165bf6e08ac814bb77cf8308b/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts#L1501-L1511) bypasses it. The new formatter therefore receives no `userMessage`.

**Candidate solutions:**

- Parse the planner result once before the status gate.
- For a valid planner `stop`, retain its summary fields while forcing the runtime-controlled closed-state reason and prohibiting dispatch.
- Add a close-during-planning regression.

**Comments:** This preserves the runtime safety gate while meeting the PR’s cumulative-summary contract.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Reused fallback notes limit cleanup convergence</summary>

**Cause:** Marker upsert can update an old final note whose database ID predates artifacts created afterward. The cleanup boundary therefore excludes those later artifacts.

**Candidate solutions:**

- In a follow-up, use an update-aware boundary while explicitly excluding the current final-note node.

**Comments:** Reviewers differed on severity; synthesis classifies this as `INFO` because the failure mode only leaves additional context visible.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step

`FIX_PR`: Apply one bounded automated pass for the nullable-ID guard and closed-PR summary preservation, with focused regressions.

## Final Verdict

`MINOR_ISSUES`

## Action Items

- [ ] FIX_IN_PR: Reject null, missing, non-positive, or unsafe comment database IDs before cleanup ordering comparisons.
- [ ] FIX_IN_PR: Preserve a validated planner stop summary when the PR closes before handoff while retaining the closed-state dispatch gate.

---

| coding_style / generic | Prefer simple implementations | pass | 7/7 | The feature remains in the existing single-job orchestrator without new jobs, dependencies, subsystems, or public configuration. |

## Notes

- Weighted score: 85/92, rounded to 92. Exact head [`6ca9c6ff`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/commit/6ca9c6ffcb45010165bf6e08ac814bb77cf8308b) retains the intended seven-file scope, and its [hosted check](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/actions/runs/32230269428/job/95998373416) passed the build, 775 runtime tests, 94 workflow checks, five documentation checks, and `git diff --check`.
- The main finalization, identity separation, non-success preservation, formal-review exclusion, and child-report paths are sound.
- Smallest useful follow-up: fail closed on null/missing/non-positive ordering IDs and preserve a validated planner stop summary when the PR closes during planning, with one regression for each case.

## Findings

- **WARNING:** [`Number(node.databaseId)`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/6ca9c6ffcb45010165bf6e08ac814bb77cf8308b/.agent/src/review-summary-minimize.ts#L324-L328) converts `null` to `0`. Because marker-bearing final notes match cleanup, a trusted current note lacking ordering evidence can be minimized. Require a non-null, positive safe integer before comparison and explicitly cover null and missing IDs.
- **WARNING:** [`decidePlannerOrchestration`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/6ca9c6ffcb45010165bf6e08ac814bb77cf8308b/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts#L1501-L1527) returns on a closed PR before reading the planner response. A PR closing during planning therefore gets a generic note without the already-produced cumulative summary.
- **INFO:** When fallback upsert updates an older marker note, cleanup uses that note’s original database-ID cutoff, so generated artifacts created afterward may remain visible. This is safely incomplete but prevents full rerun convergence.

## AI Review Synthesis

<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis -->
<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis-head: 6ca9c6ffcb45010165bf6e08ac814bb77cf8308b -->

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue

PR #505 implements the lean, single-job terminal PR finalization requested by [#452](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/452) and refined in [#496](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/496). It reuses the current progress or marker note, mentions human requesters, preserves planner summaries, and conditionally collapses older trusted automation artifacts. Existing permissions, formal reviews, and child-report behavior remain intact, with focused documentation and regression coverage. The current draft is mergeable at `6ca9c6ff`, and its Test Scripts check passes.

## Review

The rubrics, Claude, and Codex reviews converge on two bounded correctness warnings while finding the primary architecture sound. Both warnings remain present at the current head; two safely deferrable cleanup and summary-quality limitations are informational.

| Issue | Severity | Disposition | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| Missing ordering IDs can hide the final note | WARNING | FIX_IN_PR | `Number(null)` becomes `0`, allowing a marker-bearing comment without ordering evidence to be treated as older and minimized. |
| Closed-PR finalization drops a planner summary | WARNING | FIX_IN_PR | The closed-state gate returns before reading an already-produced planner response, omitting a valid cumulative `stop` summary. |
| Reused fallback notes limit cleanup convergence | INFO | FOLLOW_UP | Updating an older marker note retains its original database-ID cutoff, so newer generated artifacts can remain visible. |
| Summary-quality gate accepts any non-empty text | INFO | FOLLOW_UP | Cleanup treats every non-empty `userMessage` as substantive; the planner prompt mitigates this, making stricter validation optional hardening. |

## Progress

- The implementation already uses the job token for progress replacement, cleans both agent and workflow identities, and requires a non-empty planner summary before cleanup.
- Exact head `6ca9c6ff` passes the hosted build/test checks and `git diff --check`; no release notes were changed.
- Existing unresolved inline threads already cover the [nullable-ID defect](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/505#discussion_r3811284152) and [closed-PR summary loss](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/505#discussion_r3811286600).
- No new inline comments or replies were posted, and no comments or threads were minimized or resolved.
- There is no meaningful disagreement on the shared findings. Claude alone noted the optional summary-quality hardening; the other current artifacts did not address it.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Missing ordering IDs can hide the final note</summary>

**Cause:** The [ordering predicate](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/6ca9c6ffcb45010165bf6e08ac814bb77cf8308b/.agent/src/review-summary-minimize.ts#L324-L328) accepts `null` as zero. Because the matcher includes terminal-marker notes, cleanup can select the current note when its ordering ID is unavailable.

**Candidate solutions:**

- Require a non-null, positive safe integer before comparison.
- Add null and missing-ID regressions asserting that no minimization occurs.

**Comments:** The runtime likelihood is low, but this is a small fail-closed guard protecting the PR’s durable final artifact.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Closed-PR finalization drops a planner summary</summary>

**Cause:** [`decidePlannerOrchestration`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/6ca9c6ffcb45010165bf6e08ac814bb77cf8308b/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts#L1501-L1527) checks PR state before calling `readPlannerDecision()`. If the PR closes during planning, the generated note retains the closed-state reason but loses a valid planner `stop` summary.

**Candidate solutions:**

- Parse the planner response once before the status gate.
- Preserve summary fields only from a validated planner `stop`, while forcing the runtime-controlled closed-state reason and prohibiting dispatch.
- Add a close-during-planning regression.

**Comments:** This affects the `orchestrate` source path; normal review, approval, and merge outcomes already retain their summaries.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Reused fallback notes limit cleanup convergence</summary>

**Cause:** Marker upsert can update an old final note whose database ID predates artifacts created afterward. That old ID remains the cleanup boundary.

**Candidate solutions:**

- In a follow-up, derive an update-aware boundary while explicitly excluding the current final-note node.

**Comments:** This safely leaves excess context visible rather than hiding required context, so it does not warrant expanding this PR.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Summary-quality gate accepts any non-empty text</summary>

**Cause:** [`hasSubstantiveTerminalSummary`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/6ca9c6ffcb45010165bf6e08ac814bb77cf8308b/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts#L1133-L1134) only trims and checks for non-empty text.

**Candidate solutions:**

- Keep the prompt-enforced contract unless concrete failures emerge.
- If stricter behavior becomes necessary, first define a deterministic substantive-summary contract and add focused tests.

**Comments:** Tightening this now risks subjective heuristics and unnecessary scope expansion.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step

`FIX_PR`: Apply one bounded pass that makes candidate-ID ordering fail closed and preserves validated stop summaries when a PR closes during planning, with focused regressions.

## Final Verdict

`MINOR_ISSUES`

## Action Items

- [ ] FIX_IN_PR: Reject null, missing, non-positive, or unsafe candidate database IDs before cleanup comparisons, with regression coverage.
- [ ] FIX_IN_PR: Preserve a validated planner `stop` summary when a PR closes during planning without permitting dispatch, with regression coverage.
